tara_cs: Heads-up: PioneerHealth (pilot) requested toronto-edge peering + temp allowlist and a short QPS bump for their migration test. They asked for 200 qps for 3 hours starting 2026-04-02 10:00 ET. Need approval and CIDR add.

quentin_se: Can do toronto routing and org allowlist. Ask them to provide CIDRs + TLS cert thumbprint. We'll stage a canary at 08:00 ET. Command I'm planning: `redwoodctl org update-ratelimit --org=pioneerhealth-org --qps=200 --until=2026-04-02T13:00:00-04:00` and `redwoodctl network add-cidr --org=pioneerhealth-org --cidr=AS-SET` (will replace AS-SET with actual nets).

pioneerops: Sending CIDRs now: `152.95.8.0/22`, `152.95.12.0/22`. Cert thumbprint sent to @quentin_se DM. We'll run tests 10:15 ET and provide a short checklist.

nico_sre: Reviewed nets. I'll create peering ACL and eBGP route to toronto-edge. Need contact email for the handshake ticket. Also setting circuit probes and a short rollback plan (auto-revert at 10:30 if high error rate).

harry_am: Noted. I'll schedule a renewal check-in; renewal is 28 days out. This spike could affect MRR tiers; flagging for commercial review. I'll also capture enablement notes and ask Pioneer for subjective feedback after the test.

quentin_se: PR created: infra#4599 to add CIDRs and ratelimit override. Canary in staging @08:00 ET, prod rollout 09:45 ET. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4599

deploy-bot: chore/infra #4599 created by quentin_se: Add PioneerHealth CIDRs + temp rate override. ETA rollout 1h. CI: passed.

nico_sre: Applying ACLs after PR merge. Health-check script: `scripts/peering-health.sh toronto-edge pioneerhealth 10` (10 iterations). Will post probe summary.

tara_cs: Thanks. I'll run the enablement demo at 10:20 ET and collect feedback on latency and model output quality. Pioneer asked for a post-test survey link; can someone post a simple form after?

harry_am: I'll send a NPS-style 3-question form and add a renewal note: "usage increased during migration; consider tier bump conversation".

deploy-bot: deploy status: PR merged, infra job started. Rollout 0/4 nodes updated. Will update every 3m.

quentin_se: Monitoring metrics: token rate + p95 latency dashboards pinned. If p95 > 350ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% revert to 50 qps.

pioneerops: Appreciate the coordination. We'll standby for the canary and report test results. Thanks team.
